verdict.rationale: Docs confirm official AWS SDKs exist as a first-class way to call SES (alongside SMTP and direct API calls), which supports programmatic/agentic integration. However, evidence never lists specific SDK languages, versions, GitHub repos, or code samples, and no independent/hands-on corroboration of SDK developer experience is present. missing for 10: specific SDK language list, code examples/quickstarts, independent developer corroboration of SDK usability.
